description: This Swift source file defines data structures, a singleton class, and functions for managing and refreshing a list of nodes within an application. It includes network request handling, concurrency control, and logging related to node management.

classes.name: NodesStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the list of nodes, handles periodic refresh operations, and maintains connection state and error information.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic refresh process, ensuring only one loop runs at a time.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic refresh process if it is running.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous network request to fetch the latest list of nodes and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Utility method to determine if an error is due to cancellation.
